Method of Attack: Abusing vulnerable routers' UPnP port mapping tables to mask the source port of amplification DDoS attacks, allowing attackers to bounce malicious packets off routers to hide the true source port and evade detection by DDoS mitigation systems.
Impacted Systems: Home routers with vulnerable UPnP implementations
Attack Vector: Exploitation of UPnP protocol vulnerabilities in routers to poison port mapping tables and redirect incoming Internet IP:port connections to other Internet IPs, effectively using routers as proxies for DDoS reflection/amplification attacks.
